hostname rc1
log file /var/log/frr/frr.log informational
!
! rc1 - client edge router. Client network 10.90.1.1/32 sits behind it.
!
! PRIMARY PATH : rc1 -> r1 -> r2 -> rc2
! STANDBY PATH : rc1 -> r3 -> r4 -> rc2
ip forwarding
!
interface eth0
 description uplink to rc1
 ip address 10.90.0.11/24
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.90.1.1/32
!
! ---- static routes ----
! Floating/dual-path: standby via r3 (10.90.0.15) is preferred while the
! primary path is up.  If r1 (10.90.0.12) fails, these lower-metric routes
! keep client<->server traffic flowing over rc1 -> r3 -> r4 -> rc2.
ip route 10.90.8.1/32 10.90.0.15
ip route 10.90.2.2/32 10.90.0.15
ip route 10.90.3.2/32 10.90.0.15
! Primary path via r1 - only selected if r1 is reachable and r3 path is not.
ip route 10.90.8.1/32 10.90.0.12 200
ip route 10.90.2.2/32 10.90.0.12 200
ip route 10.90.3.2/32 10.90.0.12 200
!
line vty
EOF
echo "--- new frr.conf written ---"; grep -n "ip route" /etc/frr/frr.conf

vtysh -c "write memory" 2>&1; echo "=== reload to validate persisted file ==="; /usr/lib/frr/frrcommon.sh reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || /etc/init.d/frr reload >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 6; ps aux | grep -E "zebra|staticd" | grep -v grep; echo "=== frr.log ==="; tail -n 12 /var/log/frr/frr.log
